project_title: MyGenie PMS - CR-358-P4 (S2 Tape Chart & S7 Room Status Board)

grid_structure.left_column: Room Numbers (r1-r5) and Room Types (executive, suite)
grid_structure.time_columns: 14-day date headers with day name and date number
grid_structure.today_marker: Vertical prominent accent line on current date column

reservation_blocks.positioning: Spans check-in date to check-out date across date columns
reservation_blocks.content: Guest name, channel logo/source (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, Direct), stay nights count
reservation_blocks.interaction: Click block -> opens Popover/Modal with booking details

unassigned_section.title: Unassigned OTA & Direct Reservations
unassigned_section.description: Reservations awaiting room assignment (e.g. Test Guest - suite, BDC7497606)
unassigned_section.styling: Dashed border cards at bottom of tape chart grid with Assign Room button

S7_ROOM_STATUS_BOARD.title: S7 Room Status Board (RoomStatusPage)
S7_ROOM_STATUS_BOARD.layout: Card grid with 1 tile per room (r1-r5)

bulk_actions.mark_all_clean_btn: Action button to bulk-clear housekeeping status
bulk_actions.auto_hk_indicator: Badge indicating Auto-HK on Checkout is Enabled

room_tile_card.indicator: 4px left border indicator reflecting room status color

toggle_buttons.hk_toggle: Button to toggle room status to Housekeeping / Clean
toggle_buttons.ooo_toggle: Button to mark room as Out of Order or Resolve

instructions_to_main_agent: Create or update /app/frontend/public/cr358-p4-pms-mockup.html as a single standalone, fully interactive HTML file.
Implement top navigation bar or tab header allowing seamless switching between S2 (Tape Chart) and S7 (Room Status Board).
Strictly follow design system tokens: Poppins heading font, Inter body font, Brand Orange #F26B33, Action Green #329937, Danger #EF4444, Muted #888888, Page BG #F7F7F7, Border #E5E5E5.
Do NOT use any forbidden tailwind blue or slate colors (#22C55E, #3B82F6, #2563EB, slate classes).
Populate all room tiles (r1-r5) and tape chart rows with exact data matching the API payload above.
Ensure all interactive elements (toggles, popovers, filter buttons, tab switches) work dynamically via inline JavaScript with data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use forbidden tailwind/slate colors (#22C55E, #3B82F6, slate family).
All interactive elements and key headers must include data-testid attributes.
Do not change HTML structure, layout, annotations, pins, or OD tables unless necessary for phase 4 mockups.
Ensure high contrast meeting WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
Maintain strict adherence to Poppins font and PMS design tokens.
